subject: general
question:
Find the mode for the following data of student ages:

16, 17, 15, 17, 16, 15, 14, 14, 13, 17, 13, 12, 12, 16, 10, 14, 17, 10, 11.
solution:
Given:

The given data,

16, 17, 15, 17, 16, 15, 14, 14, 13, 17, 13, 12, 12, 16, 10, 14, 17, 10, 11

Concept used:

Mode is the most repeated value in a data

Calculations:

Values most repeated in the given data,

⇒ 16 = 3 times

⇒ 14 = 3 times

⇒ 17 = 4 times

The most repeated term,

Mode = 17

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
